item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - VICTORIOUS Official Instrumentals (~2021 Leak)
item.description:
hii! does anyone happen to have any of the official victorious instrumentals that leaked a few years back?

i was recently informed that a couple of them, including make it shine, freak the freak out, best friend's brother, and maybe more had leaked on dbree(?) back in 2021. unfortunately, that site is now dead, so i'm desperately trying to find them. the only one i was successful in finding was beggin' on your knees, so i'd be super grateful if anyone could help me out with the rest!! <3
